lead_headline: Restaurant tracker adds 3 leads as Bandar Grill (Sunnyside Mediterranean), DiFranco's (Westminster Italian), and Chick-fil-A (Stapleton drive-thru) expand metro dining options

restaurant.blurb: 3 new leads today: Bandar Grill (Sunnyside Mediterranean), DiFranco's (Westminster Italian expansion), Chick-fil-A (Stapleton drive-thru-only flagship). Pipeline: 121 (63 openings, 58 closures).

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Saturday extends weekend filing drought as operators await Monday's rush. The 7-day total drops to 10 applications — a sharp 47% decline from last week's 19 filings, signaling licensing velocity has decelerated after mid-April's surge. Friday's shutdown (zero filings) preceded today's continued silence, marking the slowest weekly pace since early March. The dropoff follows a restaurant-heavy Wednesday that included The Pit Shop and Culture before Thursday-Friday's predictable collapse.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday (Instagram) pushes 7-day total to 49 across 9 sources — up 11% from last week's 44 and reversing four consecutive weekly declines. Instagram (13) dominates weekly pickups ahead of Facebook/X.com (7 each), Reddit/Denver Post (5 each). The 49-mention week marks the strongest performance since early April, driven by City budget scrutiny (Instagram), Asia Center strip mall coverage (Facebook), and downtown foot traffic analysis. Week-over-week growth signals media interest has stabilized after March-April's descent.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 yesterday (3 new, 1 canceled) lifts MTD to +31 (+1.3/day) and 90-day net to +138. This week's +15 net (28 new, 13 canceled) surges 67% above last week's +9 performance, reversing late-April's mid-month stall. The last 6 days delivered +14 net after April 11-19's flatline (+1 net across 9 days), signaling conversions have reignited heading into month-end. MTD's +1.3/day pace now matches YTD's +1.4/day rate as April's late momentum erases earlier underperformance.
